children: U.S. water utility's Q3 operating revenue rose yr/yr on higher demand and rate increases
Diluted EPS for Q3 increased yr/yr
Company seeking $2.5 mln in additional annual revenues from NJBPU rate petitions
Company plans total 2026 infrastructure investment of about $126 mln
Company to continue focus on infrastructure investment and selective growth under MWC 2030 Vision
WHOLESALE DEMAND & RATE INCREASES - Co said higher wholesale demand, customer consumption and base rate increases drove revenue growth in the Middlesex System
CUSTOMER GROWTH - Co said customer growth and higher consumption, along with rate increases, boosted Tidewater System revenues
HIGHER PRODUCTION COSTS - Co said increased variable production and employee costs were driven by higher customer demand
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the water & related utilities peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Middlesex Water Company is $64.00, about 15.6% above its October 28 closing price of $55.38
The stock recently traded at 20 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
